name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Cho goes with exactly two of Engineer, Ganymede, and Diatoms.
Either Engineer goes with Dasari or Medic goes with Algae.
Between Engineer and Technician, one goes with Luna and the other with Diatoms.
Titan goes with exactly two of Cho, Navigator, and Diatoms.
Either Medic goes with Ganymede, or Luna goes with Diatoms — but not both.
Between Dasari and Fontaine, one goes with Medic and the other with Navigator.
Either Dasari goes with Medic or Engineer goes with Luna.
If Rios does not go with Fungus, then Algae goes with Engineer.

hints.text: Suppose Fontaine went with Technician — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Fontaine goes with Technician.
Fontaine goes with Technician, so it can't also go with Medic.
Fontaine goes with Technician, so it can't also go with Navigator.
…but now the clue “Between Dasari and Fontaine, one goes with Medic and the other with Navigator” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Fontaine does not go with Technician.
